```{r Load clean_names_lowercase function}
clean_names_lowercase <- function(x) {
  x <- iconv(x, from = "", to = "UTF-8", sub = "")
  x <- stringi::stri_trans_general(x, "Latin-ASCII")
  x %>%
    tolower() %>%
    trimws()
}
```

# >> 1. FOFM: FISH OIL, FISH MEAL ------------------------------
Assume that ~70% forage fish is used for fish oil fish meal

## Take Stock_Status of FOFM taxa (reference point):
Reference point: the stock status (B/Bmsy) of taxa used for fish oil and fish meal (i.e., small pelagics) is close to 1 across regions x year
Reference period: 2018-2024

Model: Calculate the average stock_status of small pelagics (region x year), weight geometrically by total catch per stock (region x year).

## Pull matching stock_status scores for FOFM taxa:
Reference point: All fish oil fish meal stocks are sustainably harvested.
Reference period: 2018-2024 (duration of stock status scores)
```{r Create FOFM_StockStatus list}
unique(StockStatus_Scores$Major_Functional_Group)

FOFM_Taxa<- c("anchovy & sardine (small pelagics)")

colnames(StockStatus_Scores)

FOFM_StockStatus<- StockStatus_Scores %>%
  filter(Major_Functional_Group %in% FOFM_Taxa) %>%
    select(year, Major_Functional_Group,
           estimated_genus_name, estimated_family_name,
           OHI_region_est,
           total_weight_mt,
           StockStatus_final,
           StockStatus_source
         )

# 80 obs., 8 vars.

unique(FOFM_StockStatus$estimated_genus_name)
# 7 unique genera of small pelagic fish.
```

```{r Apply FOFM correction factor: 70% of all catch goes to Fish Oil Fish Meal}
FOFM_PROPORTION<- 0.70

FOFM_StockStatus<- FOFM_StockStatus %>%
  mutate(
    FOFM_weight_mt= total_weight_mt * FOFM_PROPORTION
  )
# 80 obs., 9 vars.
```


## Calculate FOFM_SubScores as the geometric mean of Stock_Status * FOFM_weight_mt:

```{r Weights and geometric mean}
# Calculate the proportion of catch each "Stock" (i.e. genus) contributed to its regional total during the study period:
colnames(FOFM_StockStatus)

StudyPeriod_low= 2018
StudyPeriod_high= 2024

FOFM_weights <- FOFM_StockStatus %>%
  filter(year >= StudyPeriod_low & year <= StudyPeriod_high) %>%
  group_by(estimated_genus_name, OHI_region_est) %>%
  mutate(FOFM_stock_catch_mt = sum(FOFM_weight_mt)) %>% # total tonnes across all years for each stock and region during the study period
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(OHI_region_est) %>%
  mutate(total_FOFM_catch_mt = sum(FOFM_weight_mt, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% # total tonnes catch across all years and stocks for each region
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(wprop_2018.24 = FOFM_stock_catch_mt / total_FOFM_catch_mt) %>% # proportion of catch each stock contributed to the total catch
  distinct(estimated_genus_name, OHI_region_est, wprop_2018.24)

# NOTE TO SELF: see point about geometric weights. At present, the weights reflect the relative contribution per stock to total FOFM catch (per region) DURING the 2018–2024 period. Verify with Mel that this is correct. - EMF, Sep 5 2026.


# SANITY CHECK: Do the weights add up to 1?
TEST<- FOFM_weights %>%
  group_by(OHI_region_est) %>%
  summarize(sum_w = sum(wprop_2018.24, na.rm= TRUE))
# 9 obs., vars.; all = 1. Yup, looks good!
```

```{r Add weights data to Stock Status df:}
colnames(FOFM_weights)

FOFM_SubScores0 <- FOFM_StockStatus %>%
  left_join(FOFM_weights,
            by = c("OHI_region_est", "estimated_genus_name"))


colnames(FOFM_SubScores0)

# This is the geometric mean part:
FOFM_SubScores0 <- FOFM_SubScores0 %>%
  group_by(OHI_region_est, year) %>%
  summarize(
    StockStatus_geo.mean = prod(StockStatus_final ^ wprop_2018.24, na.rm = TRUE),
    Stock_landed.biomass_mt = sum(FOFM_weight_mt, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(FOFM_score= StockStatus_geo.mean * 100)

# 31 obs., 5 vars.
```

```{r Complete the FOFM_SubScores grid}
FOFM_SubScores <- FOFM_SubScores0 %>%
  complete(
    OHI_region_est = paste0("region_", 1:9),
    year = full_seq(year, 1),
    fill = list(
      StockStatus_geo.mean = NA_real_,
      FOFM_score = NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(OHI_region_est, year)

# 64 obs., 5 vars.

# Exclusion criteria?
summary(FOFM_SubScores$Stock_landed.biomass_mt) # median = 295.8, mean = 88314.0
exclusion_threshold = median(FOFM_SubScores$Stock_landed.biomass_mt, na.rm= TRUE)

FOFM_SubScores$region_exclude_include<- c(NA)

FOFM_SubScores <- FOFM_SubScores %>%
  group_by(OHI_region_est) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_regional_catch_mt = mean(Stock_landed.biomass_mt, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    region_exclude_include = case_when(
      is.na(mean_regional_catch_mt) ~ "exclude",
      mean_regional_catch_mt <= exclusion_threshold ~ "exclude",
      mean_regional_catch_mt > exclusion_threshold ~ "include"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
# 64 obs., 7 vars.
```

```{r Sanity check final FOFM_SubScores}
colnames(FOFM_SubScores)

summary(FOFM_SubScores$FOFM_score)

  #  Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max.    NA's 
  # 24.13   55.86   85.73   74.42  100.00  100.00      33 

# Year 2024 mean for FOFM_SubScores:
mean(FOFM_SubScores$FOFM_score[FOFM_SubScores$year == 2024], na.rm = TRUE)
# 75.5
```

# >> FLAG likely natural products based on record details:

```{r Remove entries where no weight whatsoever is logged: NP_Landings}
colnames(GOC_MarineFisheryLandings)

NP_Landings00 <- GOC_MarineFisheryLandings %>%
  filter(!(is.na(weight_kg_corrected) | weight_kg_corrected == 0)) %>%
  select(-recorded_taxa_name, -recorded_taxa_name_clean,
         -live_weight, -landed_weight, 
         -keywords_1, -keywords_2, -keywords_3, -keywords_4, 
         everything(),
         recorded_taxa_name, recorded_taxa_name_clean,
         keywords_1, keywords_2, keywords_3, keywords_4,
         live_weight, landed_weight) %>%
  select(-c(weight_kg_corrected))

colnames(NP_Landings00)
dim(NP_Landings00)
# 3136896 obs., 49 vars.
```

```{r First check if there is a discrepancy between wet weight and landed weight}
colnames(NP_Landings00)

NP_Landings0 <- NP_Landings00 %>%
  mutate(live.landed_discrepancy = case_when(
    !is.na(live_weight) &
    !is.na(landed_weight) &
    live_weight > landed_weight ~
      "live weight is greater than landed weight",

    !is.na(live_weight) &
    !is.na(landed_weight) &
    live_weight < landed_weight ~
      "landed weight is greater than live weight; likely error?",

    !is.na(live_weight) &
    !is.na(landed_weight) &
    live_weight == landed_weight ~
      "live weight equals landed weight",

    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

table(NP_Landings0$live.landed_discrepancy)
# landed weight is greater than live weight; likely error? 
#                                                    37135 (1.1% of all data)
#                         live weight equals landed weight 
#                                                  1648629 
#                live weight is greater than landed weight 
#                                                  1451132
```


# DECISON POINT: Dead_keywords verus Alive_keywords.

```{r Make an alive or dead column}

Dead_keywords<- c(
  
  # Frozen, cooked, dried:
  "CONG", "CONGELADO",
  "COCINERO", "COCIDO", "COCIDA", "COCIDAS", "ASADO",
  "SECO DE", "SECA", "SECA DE", "SECO",
  
  # Fillets:
  "FILETE", "FILETE DE", "ECA", "ECO", "FILETE DE ECO", "DESHUESADA", "CARNE", "CARNE DE",
  "DESCABEZADO", "DES", "DSC", "DESC", "DESV", "DESVICERADO",
  "S.C.", "S/C", "S", # I am pretty sure this means "without shell" - May 04 2026
  
  # Shells and pearls:
  "CONCHA DE", "CONCHA", "CONCHA NACAR",
  "PERLAS", "MEDIAS PERLAS",
  
  # Fin:
  "ALETA", "ALETA ECA DE", "ALETA FCA DE",
  
  # Animal parts typically sold as fillets:
  "MANTO", "MANTO DE", "TUBO DE", "TUBO",
  "TENTACULOS DE", "TENTACULOS",
  "PULPA DE", "PULPA FRESCA", 
  # "PULPO DE", # NOT TO SELF: I think this is octopus (live, dead). - Sep 5
  "COLAS DE", 
  "MANOS DE", "MANOS", "ANCAS DE", "ANCAS", "ANCA",
  
  # Other animal parts typically sold as RESD:  
  "CABEZA DE", "CABEZA",
  "BUCHE DE", "BUCHE", "TRIPA DE", "TRIPA",
  "PIEL DE ECA", "PIEL DE SECA", "PIEL DE", "PIEL",
  "POLVO DE"
)

Alive_keywords<- c("VIVO", "VIVA", "VIVAS", "VIVITA") # living / live

# Assign alive, dead, unknown based on keywords:
NP_Landings0 <- NP_Landings0 %>%
  mutate(
    Alive.Dead = case_when(
      
      # DEAD FIRST (safer precedence)
      if_any(keywords_1:keywords_4,
             ~ str_detect(.x, str_c(Dead_keywords, collapse = "|"))) ~ "dead",
      
      # ALIVE
      if_any(keywords_1:keywords_4,
             ~ str_detect(.x, str_c(Alive_keywords, collapse = "|"))) ~ "alive",
      
      # DEFAULT
      TRUE ~ "unknown, assumed dead"
    )
  )

dim(NP_Landings0)
# 3136896 obs., 51 vars.
```

# Estimate the weight of animal versus fillet versus residues:
If SoldWhole_FLAG == "YES" & live.landed_discrepancy== "landed weight is greater than live weight; likely error?" then recorded_weightOFanimal_kg = landed_weight & recorded_weightOFfillet_kg = live_weight
If SoldWhole_FLAG == "YES" & live.landed_discrepancy== "live weight equals landed weight" then recorded_weightOFanimal_kg = live_weight & recorded_weightOFfillet_kg = NA
If SoldWhole_FLAG == "YES" & live.landed_discrepancy== "live weight is greater than landed weight; suggests catch prepared before sold" then recorded_weightOFanimal_kg = live_weight & recorded_weightOFfillet_kg = landed_weight

If (Fillet_FLAG == "YES" | Residue_FLAG == "YES")  & live.landed_discrepancy== "landed weight is greater than live weight; likely error?" then recorded_weightOFanimal_kg = landed_weight & recorded_weightOFfillet_kg = live_weight
If (Fillet_FLAG == "YES" | Residue_FLAG == "YES") & live.landed_discrepancy== "live weight equals landed weight" then recorded_weightOFanimal_kg = NA & recorded_weightOFfillet_kg = landed_weight
If (Fillet_FLAG == "YES" | Residue_FLAG == "YES") & live.landed_discrepancy== "live weight is greater than landed weight; suggests catch prepared before sold" then recorded_weightOFanimal_kg = live_weight & recorded_weightOFfillet_kg = landed_weight

```{r Make a recorded_weightOFanimal_kg and recorded_weightOFfillet_kg columns}

NP_Landings0 <- NP_Landings0 %>%
  mutate(
    recorded_weightOFanimal_kg = case_when(
      
      (Residue_FLAG == "YES") & (live_weight == 0) ~ NA_real_,
      
      SoldWhole_FLAG == "YES" &
        live.landed_discrepancy == "landed weight is greater than live weight; likely error?" ~ landed_weight,
      
      SoldWhole_FLAG == "YES" &
        live.landed_discrepancy == "live weight equals landed weight" ~ live_weight,
      
      SoldWhole_FLAG == "YES" &
        live.landed_discrepancy == "live weight is greater than landed weight" ~ live_weight,
      
      (Fillet_FLAG == "YES" | Residue_FLAG == "YES") &
        live.landed_discrepancy == "landed weight is greater than live weight; likely error?" ~ landed_weight,
      
      (Fillet_FLAG == "YES" | Residue_FLAG == "YES") &
        live.landed_discrepancy == "live weight equals landed weight" ~ NA_real_,
      
      (Fillet_FLAG == "YES" | Residue_FLAG == "YES") &
        live.landed_discrepancy == "live weight is greater than landed weight" ~ live_weight,
      
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    recorded_weightOFfillet_kg = case_when(
      
      SoldWhole_FLAG == "YES" ~ NA_real_,
      Residue_FLAG == "YES" ~ NA_real_,
      
      (Fillet_FLAG == "YES") &
        live.landed_discrepancy == "landed weight is greater than live weight; likely error?" ~ live_weight,
      
      (Fillet_FLAG == "YES") &
        live.landed_discrepancy == "live weight equals landed weight" ~ landed_weight,
      
      (Fillet_FLAG == "YES") &
        live.landed_discrepancy == "live weight is greater than landed weight" ~ landed_weight,
      
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    recorded_weightOFresidue_kg = case_when(
      
      SoldWhole_FLAG == "YES" ~ NA_real_,
      Fillet_FLAG == "YES" ~ NA_real_,
      
      (Residue_FLAG == "YES") & (live_weight == 0) ~ landed_weight,
      (Residue_FLAG == "YES") & (landed_weight == 0) ~ live_weight,
      
      (Residue_FLAG == "YES") & live.landed_discrepancy == "landed weight is greater than live weight; likely error?" ~ live_weight,
      
      (Residue_FLAG == "YES") &
        live.landed_discrepancy == "live weight equals landed weight" ~ landed_weight,
      
      (Residue_FLAG == "YES") &
        live.landed_discrepancy == "live weight is greater than landed weight" ~ landed_weight,
      
      (Residue_FLAG == "YES") &
        is.na(live.landed_discrepancy) ~ landed_weight,
      
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
```

```{r FLAG likely NPs based on keywords in the record's preparation landing site and common name}
Keyword_opposite.pattern <- paste0("\\b(", paste(NP_opposite.clues, collapse = "|"), ")\\b")

      if_any(keywords_1:keywords_4, ~ str_detect(.x, regex(Keyword_weak.pattern, ignore_case = TRUE))) ~ "MAYBE",
      if_any(keywords_1:keywords_4, ~ str_detect(.x, regex(Keyword_opposite.pattern, ignore_case = TRUE))) ~ "NO",
      TRUE ~ "NO"
    ),
    
    NP.Site_FLAG = case_when(
      str_detect(landing_site_clean, regex(LandingSite_pattern, ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "YES",
      TRUE ~ "NO"
    ),
    
    NP.Group_FLAG = case_when(
      str_detect(recorded_taxa_group, regex(TaxaGroup_pattern, ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "YES",
      TRUE ~ "NO"
    ),
    
    NP.TaxaName_FLAG = case_when(
      str_detect(recorded_taxa_name_clean, regex(TaxaName_strong.pattern, ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "YES",
      str_detect(recorded_taxa_name_clean, regex(TaxaName_weak.pattern, ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "MAYBE",
      TRUE ~ "NO"
    )
  )
```

## Calculate AQRM reference points:
Reference point: "Production stays steady." I have interpreted this as: production of aquarium trade taxa should be stable, at or near, the 2018-2022 mean production (in kg). With no penalty for under harvest (added September 5 2026).
Reference period: 2018-2022

```{r Calculate AQRM reference point}
colnames(AQRM_Landings_summary)

# Sum this year (by region) and compare to the mean annual regional volume over 2018–2022:
AQRM_ref_points <- AQRM_Landings_summary %>%
  filter(year >= 2018 & year <= 2022) %>%
  group_by(OHI_region_est) %>%
  summarise(mean_prod_2018_2022 = mean(tot_annual_prod_kg, na.rm = TRUE))
# 10 obs., 2 vars.
```

## Calculate AQRM_SubScores:
```{r Calculate AQRM_SubScores}

# Prep AQRM_SubScores0:
AQRM_SubScores0<- AQRM_Landings_summary %>%
  left_join(AQRM_ref_points,
    by= c("OHI_region_est")
  ) %>%
  filter(year >= 2018 & year <= 2024)
# 65 obs., 4 vars.

colnames(AQRM_SubScores0)

# Score = 1 when annual_prod_kg is within ±10% of mean_prod_2018_2022
# If annual production is within ±10% of the 2018–2022 average (90%–110% of the average), the subscore is 1.
# If annual production exceeds 110% of the 2018–2022 average, the subscore is 1 - ratio, with a minimum of 0.
# If annual production is less than 90% of the 2018–2022 average, the subscore equals the production ratio.
# For example, if production is 80% of the average (ratio = 0.8), the subscore is 0.8.
# If production is 50% of the average (ratio = 0.5), the subscore is 0.5.

AQRM_SubScores <- AQRM_SubScores0 %>%
  filter(year >= 2018 & year <= 2024) %>%
  mutate(
    ratio = tot_annual_prod_kg / mean_prod_2018_2022,

    AQRM_score_prop = case_when(
      ratio < 0.9 ~ ratio,
      ratio >= 0.9 & ratio <= 1.1 ~ 1,
      ratio > 1.1  ~ pmax(0, 1 - abs(1-ratio))
    ),
    
    AQRM_score= AQRM_score_prop * 100
  )
# 65 obs., 7 vars.
```

```{r Complete the AQRM_SubScore grid}
colnames(AQRM_SubScores0)

AQRM_SubScores <- AQRM_SubScores %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  complete(
    OHI_region_est = paste0("region_", 1:9),
    year = full_seq(year, 1),
    fill = list(
      AQRM_score = NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(OHI_region_est, year)

# 66 obs., 7 vars.

# Exclusion criteria?
summary(AQRM_SubScores$tot_annual_prod_kg) # median = 15062, mean = 259458
sd(AQRM_SubScores$tot_annual_prod_kg, na.rm = TRUE) # sd = 379371
exclusion_threshold = median(AQRM_SubScores$tot_annual_prod_kg, na.rm= TRUE)

AQRM_SubScores$region_exclude_include<- c(NA)

AQRM_SubScores <- AQRM_SubScores %>%
  group_by(OHI_region_est) %>%
  mutate(
    median_regional_prod_kg = median(tot_annual_prod_kg, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    region_exclude_include = case_when(
      is.na(median_regional_prod_kg) ~ "exclude",
      median_regional_prod_kg <= exclusion_threshold ~ "exclude",
      median_regional_prod_kg > exclusion_threshold ~ "include"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
# 66 obs., 9 vars.
```

```{r Merge Region_Key to AQRM_SubScores}
AQRM_SubScores<- AQRM_SubScores %>%
  left_join(Region_Key, 
            by = "OHI_region_est")
```

```{r First estimate the mass of all shelled organisms}
SHEL_taxa_groups<- c("ABULON", "ALMEJA", "CARACOL", "OSTION", "OTRAS")
SHEL_functional_groups<- c("molluscs excl. cephalopods")

         )

       #  41199          3323         93506

  "CONCHA DE",
  "CONCHA"
)

SHEL_Production <- SHEL_Production %>%
  mutate(
    shell_ = case_when(
      if_any(keywords_1:keywords_4, ~ . %in% Shells_keywords) ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )

# If shell is true, replace the record type:
SHEL_Production <- SHEL_Production %>%
  mutate(
    record_type = case_when(
      shell_ ~ "shell",
      TRUE ~ record_type
    )
  )

# If record_type is NA make it "preparation_unknown"
SHEL_Production <- SHEL_Production %>%
  mutate(
    record_type = coalesce(record_type, "preparation unknown")
  )
```

## Calculate SHEL reference points:
Reference point: "Full utilization of harvest amount." For now, I interpret this to mean that shell mass should = 0.80 * fillet mass in a given year x region.
Reference period: 2018-2024

- I estimate that shell account for 40% of total mass, meat accounts for 50%, and fluids / other accounts for 10% of total mass. 
- This means that mass of shells sold should equal 0.80 * (filletted mass).
- This is called 'SHELL_REF_COEFF' here and can be easily changed.

```{r SHEL reference points}
SHELL_PROP_SNAIL_MASS = 0.40
FILLET_PROP_SNAIL_MASS = 0.50
SHELL_REF_COEFF = SHELL_PROP_SNAIL_MASS / FILLET_PROP_SNAIL_MASS

colnames(SHEL_Production_summary)

SHEL_Production_summary <- SHEL_Production_summary0 %>%
  group_by(year, OHI_region_est) %>%
  mutate(
    fillet_mt = first(
      total_weight_mt[record_type == "fillet"],
      default = NA_real_
    ),
    ref_point_mt = if_else(
      record_type == "shell",
      fillet_mt * SHELL_REF_COEFF,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Reshape the dataframe:

SHEL_Production_summary_wide <- SHEL_Production_summary %>%
  select(year, OHI_region_est, record_type, total_weight_mt) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = record_type,
    values_from = total_weight_mt
  ) %>%
  rename(
    sold_whole_mt = `sold whole`,
    fillet_mt = fillet,
    shell_mt = shell,
    other_residue_mt = `other residue`,
    preparation_unknown_mt = `preparation unknown`
  )

colnames(SHEL_Production_summary_wide)

# Calculate SHEL reference points:
SHEL_Production_summary_wide<- SHEL_Production_summary_wide %>%
  mutate(
    ref_point_mt= (fillet_mt) * SHELL_REF_COEFF
  ) %>%
  select(year, OHI_region_est, sold_whole_mt, fillet_mt, ref_point_mt, shell_mt, other_residue_mt, preparation_unknown_mt)
# 241 obs., 8 vars.
```


## Calculate SHEL_SubScores:

```{r Calculate SHEL_SubScores}
SHEL_SubScores0<- SHEL_Production_summary_wide %>%
  filter(year >= 2018 & year <= 2024) %>%
  mutate(
    SHEL_score_prop = (shell_mt / ref_point_mt)* 100,
    SHEL_score = pmin(SHEL_score_prop, 100)
  )
# 70 obs., 10 vars.
```

```{r Complete the SHEL_SubScores grid}
colnames(SHEL_SubScores0)

SHEL_SubScores <- SHEL_SubScores0 %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  complete(
    OHI_region_est = paste0("region_", 1:9),
    year = full_seq(year, 1),
    fill = list(
      SHEL_score = NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(OHI_region_est, year)

# 70 obs., 10 vars.

sd(SHEL_SubScores$shell_mt, na.rm = TRUE) # sd = 178.8995

SHEL_SubScores <- SHEL_SubScores %>%
  group_by(OHI_region_est) %>%
  mutate(
    median_regional_prod_mt = median(shell_mt, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    region_exclude_include = case_when(
      is.na(median_regional_prod_mt) ~ "exclude",
      median_regional_prod_mt <= exclusion_threshold ~ "exclude",
      median_regional_prod_mt > exclusion_threshold ~ "include"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
# 70 obs., 12 vars.
```

```{r Summarize RESD_Production with RESD_Production_summary}
  group_by(year,

           record_type) %>%
  summarize(
    total_weight_mt= sum(landed_weight, na.rm= TRUE)/1000
  )
# 822 obs.

# Complete the RESD_Production_summary grid:

RESD_Production_summary0 <- RESD_Production_summary0 %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  complete(
    nesting(year, 
            OHI_region_est
            ),
    record_type = RESD_record_types
  )
# 1008 obs.
```


## Calculate RESD reference points:
Reference point: "Full utilization of harvest amount." For now, I interpret this to mean that residues mass should equal approximately 0.20 * total mass - OR - ~0.3 * fillet mass in a given year x region.
Reference period: 2018-2024

- I estimate that, IN GENERAL, sale-able residues account for ~20% of total mass (MAX) while their usable (fillet) meat accounts for 60% of total mass.
- This means that residues mass should be equal to about 0.30 * (fillet mass).
- This is called 'RESD_REF_COEFF' here and can be easily changed.

```{r RESD reference points}
RESD_PROP_TOTAL_MASS = 0.20
FILLET_PROP_TOTAL_MASS = 0.60
RESD_REF_COEFF = RESD_PROP_TOTAL_MASS / FILLET_PROP_TOTAL_MASS

colnames(RESD_Production_summary)

RESD_Production_summary <- RESD_Production_summary0 %>%
  group_by(year, OHI_region_est) %>%
  mutate(
    fillet_mt = first(total_weight_mt[record_type == "fillet"], default = NA_real_),
    ref_point_mt = if_else(
      record_type == "other residue",
      fillet_mt * RESD_REF_COEFF,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Reshape the dataframe:
RESD_Production_summary_wide <- RESD_Production_summary %>%
  select(year, OHI_region_est, record_type, total_weight_mt) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = record_type,
    values_from = total_weight_mt
  ) %>%
  rename(
    sold_whole_mt = `sold whole`,
    fillet_mt = fillet,
    residue_mt = `other residue`,
    preparation_unknown_mt = `preparation unknown`,
  )

colnames(RESD_Production_summary_wide)

# Calculate RESD reference points:
RESD_Production_summary_wide<- RESD_Production_summary_wide %>%
  mutate(
    ref_point_mt= (fillet_mt) * RESD_REF_COEFF
  ) %>%
  select(year, OHI_region_est, sold_whole_mt, fillet_mt, ref_point_mt, residue_mt, preparation_unknown_mt)
# 252 obs., 7 vars.
```

## Calculate RESD_SubScores:

```{r Calculate RESD_SubScores}
RESD_SubScores <- RESD_Production_summary_wide %>%
  filter(year >= 2018, year <= 2024) %>%
  mutate(
    RESD_score_prop = case_when(
      # if residues production is lower than reference point, that's not great, score < 100
      residue_mt <= ref_point_mt ~ (residue_mt/ref_point_mt),

      # if residues production is higher than reference point then score = 100?
      residue_mt > ref_point_mt ~ 1,

      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    RESD_score = pmin(RESD_score_prop * 100, 100)
  )
# 70 obs., 9 vars.

# Exclusion criteria?
summary(RESD_SubScores$residue_mt) # median = 26.02, mean = 81.64
sd(RESD_SubScores$residue_mt, na.rm = TRUE) # sd = 117.5841

exclusion_threshold = median(RESD_SubScores$residue_mt, na.rm= TRUE)

RESD_SubScores$region_exclude_include<- c(NA)

RESD_SubScores <- RESD_SubScores %>%
  group_by(OHI_region_est) %>%
  mutate(
    median_regional_prod_mt = median(residue_mt, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    region_exclude_include = case_when(
      is.na(median_regional_prod_mt) ~ "exclude",
      median_regional_prod_mt <= exclusion_threshold ~ "exclude",
      median_regional_prod_mt > exclusion_threshold ~ "include"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
# 70 obs., 11 vars.
```

```{r Merge Region_Key to RESD_SubScores}
RESD_SubScores<- RESD_SubScores %>%
  left_join(Region_Key, 
            by = "OHI_region_est")
# 70 obs., 12 vars.
```

## Calculate FINS reference point:
Reference point: "Full utilization of harvest amount." For now, I interpret this to mean that fin mass should equal approximately 0.05 * fillet mass in a given year x region. If fin mass is more than 5% of fillet mass, then it's likely that fishers are harvesting too much fin relative to meat - or - underreporting fillet mass. - Jun 29 2026
Reference period: 2018-2024

- I estimate that a shark's fin accounts for 3% of total mass (MAX) while their usable (fillet) meat accounts for 60% of total mass.
- This means that fin mass should be equal to about 0.05 * (fillet mass).
- This is called 'SHARK_REF_COEFF' here and can be easily changed.

## Calculate first scoring component: fin_v_ref_ratio

```{r FINS catch reference point}
FIN_PROP_SHARK_MASS = 0.03
FILLET_PROP_SHARK_MASS = 0.60
SHARK_REF_COEFF = FIN_PROP_SHARK_MASS / FILLET_PROP_SHARK_MASS

colnames(FINS_Production_summary0)

FINS_Production_summary <- FINS_Production_summary0 %>%
  group_by(year, OHI_region_est) %>%
  mutate(
    fillet_mt = first(total_weight_mt[record_type == "fillet"], default = NA_real_),
    ref_point_mt = if_else(
      record_type == "fin",
      fillet_mt * SHARK_REF_COEFF,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
# 1195 obs., 6 vars.

# Reshape the dataframe:
FINS_Production_summary_wide <- FINS_Production_summary %>%
  select(year, OHI_region_est, record_type, total_weight_mt) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = record_type,
    values_from = total_weight_mt
  ) %>%
  rename(
    sold_whole_mt = `sold whole`,
    fillet_mt = fillet,
    fins_mt = fin,
    other_residue_mt = `other residue`,
    preparation_unknown_mt = `preparation unknown`
  )
# 239 obs., 7 vars.

colnames(FINS_Production_summary_wide)

# Calculate first reference point (fillet to meat):
FINS_Production_summary_wide<- FINS_Production_summary_wide %>%
  mutate(
    ref_point_mt= (fillet_mt) * SHARK_REF_COEFF
  ) %>%
  select(year, OHI_region_est, sold_whole_mt, fillet_mt, ref_point_mt, fins_mt)
```

```{r Calculate first scoring component: fin_v_ref_ratio}
FINS_Production_summary_wide<- FINS_Production_summary_wide %>%
  mutate(
    ref_v_fins_ratio = pmin(ref_point_mt / fins_mt, 1)
  )

# If ref_v_fins_ratio = 1, then amount of fins harvested equals amount we'd expect based on fillet mass. (exactly)
# If ref_v_fins_ratio < 1, then amount of fins harvested is MORE than the amount we'd expect based on fillet mass. (BAD; penalty for over-harvest)
# If ref_v_fins_ratio > 1, then amount of fins harvested is less than the amount we'd expect based on fillet mass. (NO penalty for under-harvest)
```


## Calculate second scoring component: StockStatus_geo.mean

```{r Create FINS_StockStatus list}
unique(StockStatus_Scores$Major_Functional_Group)

FINS_Taxa<- c("sharks")

colnames(StockStatus_Scores)

FINS_StockStatus0<- StockStatus_Scores %>%
  filter(Major_Functional_Group %in% FINS_Taxa) %>%
    select(year, Major_Functional_Group,
           estimated_genus_name, estimated_family_name,
           OHI_region_est,
           total_weight_mt,
           StockStatus_final,
           StockStatus_source
         )

# 546 obs., 8 vars.

unique(FINS_StockStatus0$estimated_genus_name)
# 19 unique genera of sharks

# Simplify the df:
colnames(FINS_StockStatus0)

FINS_StockStatus0<- FINS_StockStatus0 %>%
  select(year, OHI_region_est, estimated_genus_name, StockStatus_final) %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r Gapfill missing stock_status values for sharks}
# Gapfill missing stock status values. Gapfill heirachy is:
# Taxon × region × year mean
# Taxon × region mean across all years
# Taxon mean across all regions and years
# Global mean across all sharks, regions, and years

# Calculate fallback values first:

# 1. Taxon × region × year mean
taxon_region_year_mean <- FINS_StockStatus0 %>%
  group_by(estimated_genus_name, OHI_region_est, year) %>%
  summarise(
    fill_value_1 = mean(StockStatus_final, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(StockStatus_final)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    fill_value_1 = if_else(n_nonmissing > 0, fill_value_1, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  select(-n_nonmissing)


# 2. Taxon × region mean across all years
taxon_region_mean <- FINS_StockStatus0 %>%
  group_by(estimated_genus_name, OHI_region_est) %>%
  summarise(
    fill_value_2 = mean(StockStatus_final, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(StockStatus_final)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    fill_value_2 = if_else(n_nonmissing > 0, fill_value_2, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  select(-n_nonmissing)


# 3. Taxon mean across all regions and years
taxon_mean <- FINS_StockStatus0 %>%
  group_by(estimated_genus_name) %>%
  summarise(
    fill_value_3 = mean(StockStatus_final, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(StockStatus_final)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    fill_value_3 = if_else(n_nonmissing > 0, fill_value_3, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  select(-n_nonmissing)


# 4. Global mean
global_mean <- mean(FINS_StockStatus0$StockStatus_final, na.rm = TRUE)


# Create complete region × year grid for "nei" taxa:
nei_grid <- expand_grid(
  OHI_region_est = paste0("region_", 1:9),
  year = full_seq(FINS_StockStatus0$year, 1)
) %>%
  mutate(
    estimated_genus_name = "nei"
  )

# Create complete region × year grid for "NA" taxa:
na_grid <- expand_grid(
  OHI_region_est = paste0("region_", 1:9),
  year = full_seq(FINS_StockStatus0$year, 1)
) %>%
  mutate(
    estimated_genus_name = NA_character_
  )

# Add the NEI and NA grid to the existing data
FINS_StockStatus <- bind_rows(
  FINS_StockStatus0,
  nei_grid
) %>%
  arrange(OHI_region_est, year, estimated_genus_name)

FINS_StockStatus <- bind_rows(
  FINS_StockStatus,
  na_grid
)


# THEN apply gap filling hierarchy:
FINS_StockStatus <- FINS_StockStatus %>%
  left_join(
    taxon_region_year_mean,
    by = c("estimated_genus_name", "OHI_region_est", "year")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    taxon_region_mean,
    by = c("estimated_genus_name", "OHI_region_est")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    taxon_mean,
    by = "estimated_genus_name"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    provenance = case_when(
      !is.na(StockStatus_final) ~ "observed",
      !is.na(fill_value_1) ~ "gap_filled_taxon_region_year",
      !is.na(fill_value_2) ~ "gap_filled_taxon_region",
      !is.na(fill_value_3) ~ "gap_filled_taxon_all_regions_years",
      !is.na(global_mean) ~ "gap_filled_global_mean",
      TRUE ~ "missing"
    ),
    
    StockStatus_final = case_when(
      !is.na(StockStatus_final) ~ StockStatus_final,
      !is.na(fill_value_1) ~ fill_value_1,
      !is.na(fill_value_2) ~ fill_value_2,
      !is.na(fill_value_3) ~ fill_value_3,
      !is.na(global_mean) ~ global_mean,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-fill_value_1, -fill_value_2, -fill_value_3)
# 672 obs., 5 vars.
```

## Calculate weights for StockStatus_geo.mean:

```{r Weights and geometric mean}
# Calculate the proportion of catch each "Stock" (i.e. genus) contributed to its regional total during the study period:
colnames(FINS_per_Genera_Production)

StudyPeriod_low= 2018
StudyPeriod_high= 2024

FINS_per_Genera_weights <- FINS_per_Genera_Production %>%
  filter(year >= StudyPeriod_low & year <= StudyPeriod_high) %>%
  
  group_by(estimated_genus_name, OHI_region_est) %>%
  mutate(
    FINS_weight_mt = sum(est_fin_weight_mt, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  group_by(OHI_region_est) %>%
  mutate(
    total_FINS_weight_mt = sum(est_fin_weight_mt, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  mutate(
    wprop_2018.24 = FINS_weight_mt / total_FINS_weight_mt
  ) %>%
  
  distinct(
    estimated_genus_name,
    OHI_region_est,
    wprop_2018.24
  )


# NOTE TO SELF: see point about geometric weights. Verify with Mel that this is correct. - EMF, Sep 5 2026.
# Verified with group. Could use geometric or arithmetic mean. Let's go with geometric. - EMF, Sep 8 2026

# SANITY CHECK: Do the weights add up to 1?
TEST<- FINS_per_Genera_weights %>%
  group_by(OHI_region_est) %>%
  summarize(sum_w = sum(wprop_2018.24, na.rm= TRUE))
# 9 obs., 2vars. All weights = 1. Looks good!
```

## Calculate StockStatus_geo.mean:
```{r Add weights data to FINS_per_Genera_Production_summary:}
colnames(FINS_per_Genera_weights)
colnames(FINS_per_Genera_Production_summary)

FINS_per_Genera_Production_summary<- FINS_per_Genera_Production_summary%>%
  left_join(FINS_per_Genera_weights,
            by = c("OHI_region_est", "estimated_genus_name"))


# This is the geometric mean part:
FINS_SubScores0 <- FINS_per_Genera_Production_summary%>%
  group_by(OHI_region_est, year) %>%
  summarize(
    StockStatus_geo.mean = prod(StockStatus_final ^ wprop_2018.24, na.rm = TRUE),
    FINS_biomass_mt = sum(est_fin_weight_mt, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 39 obs., 4 vars.
```

## Calculate FINS_SubScores:

```{r Merge scoring components together and calculate FINS_score}
colnames(FINS_SubScores0)
colnames(FINS_Production_summary_wide)

FINS_SubScores <- FINS_SubScores0 %>%
  left_join(
    FINS_Production_summary_wide,
    by = c("year", "OHI_region_est")
  ) %>%
  select(
    OHI_region_est,
    year,
    sold_whole_mt,
    fillet_mt,
    ref_point_mt,
    fins_mt,
    FINS_biomass_mt,
    ref_v_fins_ratio,
    StockStatus_geo.mean
  )

# Remove redundant column:
FINS_SubScores<- FINS_SubScores %>%
  select(-FINS_biomass_mt)

# Calculate final FINS_score as the product of ref_v_fins_ratio * StockStatus_geo.mean * 100
FINS_SubScores<- FINS_SubScores %>%
  mutate(
    FINS_score = (ref_v_fins_ratio * StockStatus_geo.mean) * 100
  )
# 39 obs., 9 vars.
```

```{r Complete the FINS_SubScores grid}
FINS_SubScores <- FINS_SubScores %>%
  group_by(OHI_region_est) %>%
  mutate(
    median_regional_prod_mt = median(fins_mt, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    region_exclude_include = case_when(
      is.na(median_regional_prod_mt) ~ "exclude",
      median_regional_prod_mt <= exclusion_threshold ~ "exclude",
      median_regional_prod_mt > exclusion_threshold ~ "include"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
# 63 obs., 11 vars.
```

# >> 6. Coastal Salt Production (SALT) ------------------------------

Yearbooks downloaded from El Anuario Estadístico de la Minería Mexicana: https://www.sgm.gob.mx/Gobmx/productos/Anuarios-historicos.html

```{r Load in SALT_Data}
# Raw data
SALT_Data0 <- read_csv(here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/Anuario_Estadistico_de_la_Mineria_Mexicana","NP_Sal_Anuario_Estadistico_tidy_sal.csv"))
# 54 obs., 5 vars.
# Data only through 2023

# Municipio key:
MunicipioRegionKey<- read_csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/NP/v2026/NP_Keys/MunicipioRegionKey_Sep062026.csv")
# 11 obs., 3 vars.

```

```{r Merge MunicipioRegionKey to SALT_Data0}
colnames(SALT_Data0)

SALT_Data<- SALT_Data0 %>%
  left_join(MunicipioRegionKey,
    by= c("estado", "municipio")
    )
# 54 obs., 6 vars.

SALT_Data<- SALT_Data %>%
  select(year, state= estado, OHI_region= OHI_Region, municipality= municipio, 
         reported_volume_mt= volume_tons, 
         near_coast_= near_coast)
```

# Extropolate salt data (at the site level) from 2018-2023 to 2024 and 2025
```{r Extropolate SALT_Data from 2018-2023 to 2024 and 2025}
# First, take annual totals by region:
SALT_Regional_totals <- SALT_Data %>%
  select(OHI_region, year, state, municipality, reported_volume_mt) %>%
  group_by(state, municipality, year) %>%
  summarise(
    total_volume_mt = sum(reported_volume_mt, na.rm = TRUE),
    OHI_region = first(OHI_region),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Then, fit a linear trend for each region and predict 2024:
# NOTE TO SELF: Come back to this. Data is available for 2024 here: https://www.sgm.gob.mx/productos/pdf/Anuario_2024_Edicion_2025.pdf
# Use the broom library for forecast.
SALT_Regional_forecasts <- SALT_Regional_totals %>%
  group_by(OHI_region, state, municipality) %>%
  mutate(
    valid_year_flag = !is.na(total_volume_mt) & total_volume_mt > 0
  ) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    n_years_forecast_ = map_int(data, ~ sum(!is.na(.x$total_volume_mt) & .x$total_volume_mt > 0)),
    
    model = map(data, ~ lm(total_volume_mt ~ year, data = .x)),
    
    forecast = map(model, ~{
      newdata <- tibble(year = c(2024))
      newdata$predicted_volume_mt <- predict(.x, newdata = newdata)
      newdata
    })
  ) %>%
  select(OHI_region, state, municipality, forecast, n_years_forecast_) %>%
  unnest(forecast)

# Add a forecasted column:
SALT_Regional_forecasts$forecasted_<- c("TRUE")
```

```{r Merge SALT_Regional_forecasts to SALT_Data}
colnames(SALT_Data)
colnames(SALT_Regional_forecasts)

SALT_Data$forecasted_<- c("FALSE")

SALT_Data <- bind_rows(
  SALT_Data,
  SALT_Regional_forecasts
)
# 65 obs., 9 vars.
```

```{r Create cleaned SALT_Data_finalized}
colnames(SALT_Data)

SALT_Data_finalized <- SALT_Data %>%
  select(year, state, OHI_region, municipality, near_coast_,
         reported_volume_mt, predicted_volume_mt,
         forecasted_, n_years_forecast_) %>%
  mutate(
    volume_mt = coalesce(reported_volume_mt, predicted_volume_mt)
  ) %>%
  relocate(volume_mt, .after= predicted_volume_mt)
```

```{r Curious about SALT production region 7}
test<- SALT_Data_finalized %>%
  filter(OHI_region== "Region_7")

# NOTE TO SELF: I actually just don't think the salt spike in region 7 2024 is real. I think this will be corrected when we load in new Anuario data for 2024. = September 7 2026
```

## Calculate SALT reference point:
Salt reference point: "Salt production from all mines roughly equals production from Hermosillio, a great example of a good, sustainable mine."
Salt reference period: 2018-2022

```{r Calculate salt reference point}
table(SALT_Data_finalized$municipality)
colnames(SALT_Data_finalized)

# Sum this year (by region) and compare to the mean annual regional volume over 2018–2022:
SALT_ref_point <- SALT_Data_finalized %>%
  filter(municipality == "hermosillo",
         year >= 2018 & year <= 2022) %>%
  summarise(mean_volume_2018_2022 = mean(volume_mt, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(mean_volume_2018_2022)
```


## Calculate SALT_SubScores:

```{r Calculate SALT_SubScores}
colnames(SALT_Data_finalized)

# First, calculate the scores PER SALT MINE relative to the reference point:
SALT_Scores_per_mine<- SALT_Data_finalized

SALT_Scores_per_mine$ref_point_mt<- c(SALT_ref_point)

SALT_Scores_per_mine <- SALT_Scores_per_mine %>%
  mutate(
    mine_SALT_score = (volume_mt / ref_point_mt)* 100,
    mine_SALT_score = pmin(mine_SALT_score, 100)
  )

# Next take mean across all mines in that region (weight the contribution of each mine by total production):
colnames(SALT_Scores_per_mine)

SALT_SubScores0 <- SALT_Scores_per_mine %>%
  group_by(OHI_region, year) %>%
  summarise(
    regional_production_mt = sum(volume_mt, na.rm = TRUE),
    SALT_score = weighted.mean(
      mine_SALT_score,
      w = volume_mt,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    OHI_region = clean_names_lowercase(OHI_region)
  )
```

```{r Complete the SALT_SubScores grid}
colnames(SALT_SubScores0)

SALT_SubScores <- SALT_SubScores0 %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  complete(
    OHI_region = paste0("region_", 1:9),
    year = full_seq(year, 1),
    fill = list(
      SHEL_score = NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(OHI_region, year)

# Exclusion criteria? > Not sure this is necessary here.
summary(SALT_SubScores$regional_production_mt) # median = 101722, mean = 1730837
sd(SALT_SubScores$regional_production_mt, na.rm = TRUE) # sd = 2892755

exclusion_threshold = median(SALT_SubScores$regional_production_mt, na.rm= TRUE)

SALT_SubScores$region_exclude_include<- c(NA)

SALT_SubScores <- SALT_SubScores %>%
  group_by(OHI_region) %>%
  mutate(
    median_regional_prod_mt = median(regional_production_mt, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    region_exclude_include = case_when(
      is.na(median_regional_prod_mt) ~ "exclude",
      median_regional_prod_mt <= exclusion_threshold ~ "exclude",
      median_regional_prod_mt > exclusion_threshold ~ "include"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
# 70 obs., 6 vars.
```

```{r Merge Region_Key to SALT_SubScores}
SALT_SubScores <- SALT_SubScores %>%
  left_join(
    Region_Key,
    by = c("OHI_region" = "OHI_region_est")
  )
# 70 obs., 7 vars.
```

# >> OLD CALCULATION Calculate FINS_SubScores ------------------------------
## Can delete after EWG 3.3 on Sep 10 2026:

```{r Calculate FINS_SubScores0}
FINS_SubScores0 <- FINS_Production_summary_wide %>%
  mutate(
    FINS_score_prop = case_when(
      # if fin production is lower than reference point, that's good, score = 100
      fins_mt <= ref_point_mt ~ 100,

      # if fin production is higher than reference point then score goes down inversely
      fins_mt > ref_point_mt ~ (ref_point_mt / fins_mt) * 100,

      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    FINS_score = pmin(FINS_score_prop, 100)
  )
# 239 obs., 8 vars.
```


```{r Complete the FINS_SubScores grid}
colnames(FINS_SubScores0)

FINS_SubScores <- FINS_SubScores0 %>%

  ungroup() %>%
  
  complete(
    OHI_region_est = paste0("region_", 1:9),
    year = full_seq(year, 1),
    fill = list(
      SHEL_score = NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(OHI_region_est, year)

# 65 obs., 8 vars.

# Exclusion criteria?
summary(FINS_SubScores$fins_mt) # median = 3.1, mean = 18.4
sd(FINS_SubScores$fins_mt, na.rm = TRUE) # sd = 26.8

exclusion_threshold = median(FINS_SubScores$fins_mt, na.rm= TRUE)

FINS_SubScores$region_exclude_include<- c(NA)

FINS_SubScores <- FINS_SubScores %>%
  group_by(OHI_region_est) %>%
  mutate(
    median_regional_prod_mt = median(fins_mt, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    region_exclude_include = case_when(
      is.na(median_regional_prod_mt) ~ "exclude",
      median_regional_prod_mt <= exclusion_threshold ~ "exclude",
      median_regional_prod_mt > exclusion_threshold ~ "include"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
# 65 obs., 10 vars.
```

```{r Load in FINS_SubScores as needed}
  "Southern Sonora Coast",
  "Sinaloa Coast",
  "Southeastern Gulf"
)

FINS_SubScores <- FINS_SubScores %>%
  mutate(
    OHI_region_name = factor(
      OHI_region_name,
      levels = region_order
    )
  )
```

```{r Plot FINS_SubScores}
# Plot over time:
FINS_SubScores_plot <- FINS_SubScores %>%
  filter(!is.na(OHI_region_est)) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = year, 
             y = FINS_score, 
             color = OHI_region_name)) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ OHI_region_name, scales = "fixed") +
  
  labs(
    title = "NP: FINS Scores by Region",
    subtitle= "summed FINS shark taxa", 
    caption = "updated: Sep 6 2026",
    y = "FINS Current Status (0 to 100)",
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  
  ylim(c(0, 101)) +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = Region_colors) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )

FINS_SubScores_plot
```
